The '''''Lunar Tide''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] operating as part of the task force defending [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Second Battle of Borleias]] in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TNJO: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref>
